# streamtime_base_domain (Resource)

A base domain that Streamtime serves workloads under.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_base_domain" "example" {
  domain                   = "example.com"
  auto_create_certificates = true

  dns_provider_config = {
    dns_provider = {
      provider_type = "cloudflare"
      zone_id       = var.cloudflare_zone_id
      api_token     = var.cloudflare_api_token
    }
  }
}

variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "cloudflare_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_provider_config` (Attributes, Sensitive) How Streamtime proves ownership of the domain. May hold credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_provider_config))
- `domain` (String) The domain name. Changing it creates a new base domain.

### Optional

- `auto_create_certificates` (Boolean) Let Streamtime create and renew the certificate for this domain.
- `tls_cert` (String) PEM certificate to use instead of an automatic one.
- `tls_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key for tls_cert.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_expiry` (String) When the current certificate expires.
- `id` (String) Same as domain. Use the domain to import.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_provider_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_provider_config`

Required:

- `dns_provider` (Attributes) The DNS provider and its settings. Set only the fields that belong to the chosen provider_type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_provider_config--dns_provider))

<a id="nestedatt--dns_provider_config--dns_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_provider_config.dns_provider`

Required:

- `provider_type` (String) One of none, route53, stdns, cloudflare or godaddy. Use none when you supply tls_cert and tls_key yourself.

Optional:

- `api_key` (String) godaddy: API key.
- `api_secret` (String) godaddy: API secret.
- `api_token` (String) cloudflare: API token with permission to edit DNS.
- `aws_access_key` (String) route53: access key ID with permission to manage records in the zone.
- `aws_access_secret` (String) route53: secret access key paired with aws_access_key.
- `aws_region` (String) route53: AWS region.
- `cert_id` (String) stdns: legacy certificate ID. Streamtime sets it when one exists.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) route53: ID of the hosted zone that holds the records.
- `subdomain` (String) stdns: the subdomain registered with Streamtime DNS.
- `zone_apex` (String) The verified registered domain of the zone. Streamtime sets it once zone access is verified.
- `zone_id` (String) cloudflare: ID of the zone for the domain.
- `zone_record_id` (String) stdns: ID of the zone record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by domain name.
terraform import streamtime_base_domain.example example.com
```
